speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Sir, Miss Harper, the assigned
legal-aid attorney, hasn't shown up yet.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Give her a few more minutes.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Yes, sir.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Hey, Mac, you wanna see something neat?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Oh, could I, sir?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Come here.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Look. Ta-da.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Wow.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Thanks for sharing that, sir.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Those are sea monkeys, Mac.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Yeah. Cute little fellas, aren't they?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Okay, I admit they're small,
but they're definitely in there.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Your Honor, I was wondering...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Hey, Dan, come here, look at this.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Oh, Harry...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Finest sea monkeys I've ever seen.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Yeah.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I've been seeing ads for these
for years in comics.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I finally broke down and bought some.
They come in this package.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
You just add water
and stir them up, and voilâ.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Instant pets. Heh. You're really an '80s
kind of guy, aren't you, Your Honor?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Yeah. And they do tricks too. Watch this.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Look at them go, huh?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Can you see what they're doing?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Yes, sir.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: They're settling.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Sorry I'm late.
First they send me to Brooklyn,

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I get to Brooklyn,
they send me to Manhattan.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Mixed me up with some other attorney,
Sue Harper.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Same last name, short girl,
red hair, do you know her?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I grab a cab, rush over,
interview my clients and here I am.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
It's gonna be a pleasure
working with you, Judge Stone.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: That's Judge Stone.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: The guy with the jar of silt?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Welcome, Miss Harper.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Oh, Your Honor. Heh.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Ready whenever you are, sir.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Okay, just a minute, Bull.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I had another package of sea monkeys.
I thought I'd whip up a fresh batch.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Now, where are they?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - I took them, sir.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - I didn't know you wanted them both.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Oh, that's okay, Bull.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Thank you, sir.
But if you want my opinion...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...I still think the kind
with the little alphabet noodles taste better.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: First case, Your Honor.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - What do we got?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Take a peek.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
She's also there. They didn't say
there would be all these people.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Settle down, everybody. Stop the talking.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
You don't have to push me.
Hey!

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: The little fella said to be quiet.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Has this place been checked
for alien listening devices?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: All clear.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Incredible what they can do
with microchips, isn't it?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I've got a radar installation in my pants.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: It's better to be safe than sorry.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Dan, are they wearing pajamas?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Hmm? I'll check.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Hey, I really like your pajamas.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Thank you.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Yup.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Would the defense step forward, please?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I'm sorry.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - He meant me, really.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - You all don't have to come up here.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - They don't want us to hear.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - They wanna tell secrets about us.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Don't take that personally.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: He's not in his right mind.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Hey, thanks, big guy.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Mr. Prosecutor...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
He's about 7'4" and mentally unstable,
Your Honor.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Say, thanks, big guy.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - You're welcome.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
According to this,
the defendants are inpatients...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...at the Morningdale
Psychiatric Hospital.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Hey, what about me?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Pardon?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - There are five of us.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - You forgot me, stupid.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - That's Gilbert.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
He's, um, Alan's other personality,
Your Honor.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Sir, I called the hospital to let them know
that their patients are still on this planet.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Thanks, you've obviously had
prior experience with...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Unhealthy minds? Oh, yeah.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
In Nam, one guy in our unit
really burnt out all his circuits.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Went running around the compound
screaming, "Kill, kill."

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Crazy as hell, boy.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - What did they do with him?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Made him an officer.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Hi.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Hi, what's the problem?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
My father.
He never showed me any affection.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - I meant the legal problem.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Uh, Your Honor, in a nutshell...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
To summarize, uh, they took a long
taxicab ride and then refused to pay for it.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
From the West Side where
they flagged me, over to Gracie Mansion...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: ...to downtown, back to the U.N.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: You wanna talk about hell on wheels!

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Shot in the dark, cab driver?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Elmore Watkins, Your Honor.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
And when I finally dropped them
at city hall, they stiffed me.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Claimed they didn't have no money
in their pajamas.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
All right, Elmore.
There's really no need to yell.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Who's yelling? I always talk like this.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Your Honor, a brief struggle ensued.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
- Now, nothing serious...
Nothing serious?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - This guy here punched me.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - You started it, melon head.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
- That hand is lying, Your Honor.
All right.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: All right, let's put a lid on it, huh?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: My name is Wendell.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Uh, yeah, Wendell Martin.
Yes, I see that here.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Does the prosecution
have anything material to add?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: What's your name?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Dan.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Can you say "Dan"?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Dan...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Good.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Wendell, we really have to
keep things moving here.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
We only have about
three hours till dinner.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Look at the size of that guy.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Must be a gland problem.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - I bet he's taller than you.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - So, what am I, a pygmy?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
So he's taller, so what?
You're more lumbering.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Thank you, Selma.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I don't see anything to suggest
premeditation, do you, Mr. Prosecutor?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Hey, nice suit. Who shines it for you?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Why don't you put a mitten on it?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - All right, no more name-calling, huh?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - This is Ann, Your Honor.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Hi, Ann.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I don't think she'll answer you, Harry.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - She never talks at all.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Never?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
She hasn't said a word to anyone
in seven years.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Well, she ain't gonna start now.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Mr. Watkins...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Your Honor,
these people should be locked up.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
They have been locked up. And that's
exactly why they were in your cab.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Is it just me, or did you follow that?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: What I meant, Your Honor...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...is the reason they wanted Mr. Watkins
to take them someplace, anyplace...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...was so that they could report abuses
that were occurring at the hospital.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - What sort of abuses?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: We made a list.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: It's, uh, kind of hard to read.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: It's kind of hard to write on.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
They never said nothing
about reporting abuses.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
They were too busy taking turns
rolling my windows up and down.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Oh, thank God they're all right.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - They didn't kill anybody, did they?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - No.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I just want you to know
that I am very, very cross with you people.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Excuse me, you are?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Oh, Dr. Laurence Osborne,
Morningdale Hospital.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I got here as quickly as I could,
Your Honor.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Doctor, this is Dan, my new friend.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Tell your friend he dresses like a clown.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Alan, knock it off.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Don't let him fool you.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
True multiple personalities
are practically non-existent.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Isn't it possible that he's the exception?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Can't you see his lips moving?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Conference, Your Honor.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Yeah. Excuse us, doctor.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - What you got, Dan?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - A face like a grapefruit.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: We're dealing with misdemeanors.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I say we drop the charges, and get
these people back to Hotel Happiness.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Lf there's no objection...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Objection.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I don't think you understand what just
happened here. He dropped the case.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I'm not gonna let you
railroad these people out of here.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Now, judge, I feel it is imperative
that my clients be given a chance...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: ...to air their grievances in open court.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Their grievances are not the issue here.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
And besides, I think there's a
pretty big question as to their competency.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
No one has offered any proof
that they're incompetent.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Proof? The guy over there
is conversing with his fist.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I'm afraid I gotta go along
with Dan on this one, counselor.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Due to the, uh, unusual circumstances...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...the court drops the charges
against the defendants...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...and remands them
to the custody of their psychiatrist.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
All right, come along, people.
That's enough reality for one day.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - We're being poisoned, you know.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - In the hospital?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: No, no, our entire planet.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
By the forces of intergalactic evil:
Microbes, germs, bacteria...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...reproducing themselves
at a rate you would not believe.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
That's why it's so important
to brush after every meal.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Mr. Dworkin.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Hey, what about me?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Them eight-balls waltz out of here,
and I get nothing for my trouble?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Ha, ha! I don't believe this.
This is insane.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Depends on your point of view,
Mr. Watkins.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Insane seems to be a relative term.
Right, Mac?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I saw them swimming around,
I swear, sir.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Hey, did they come through here?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Who, your patients?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - As soon as I was in the corridor, they...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: ...grabbed my bag and made a run for it.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Bull, seal off the building.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - For Heaven's sakes, get that bag back.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - I assume there were drugs in that bag?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Among other things.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Among what other things?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Well, a syringe, a stethoscope,
a blood-pressure cuff...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: ...a revolver. Ahem.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Did you say a revolver?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Mac, call security.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Look, my wife always worries
about my safety...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...so she gave it to me
as an anniversary present.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Eleven years, that's steel.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - What do I tell security, sir?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
We're looking for mentally unhinged people
that have a bagful of drugs and a weapon.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Yeah, and one of them is 7'4"
and they're all wearing pajamas.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I wanna listen on the extension.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I really didn't need this.
If anything happens, I'll feel so responsible.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: You are responsible.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
All right, people,
let's not chew up the furniture, huh?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I'm sure they're still here
in the building...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: ...somewhere.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Oh, Wendell, what are you doing?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Hiding.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Ain't gonna work for you indoors, Wendell.
No cloud cover.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Wendell, where are the others?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
All I know is,
they don't wanna go back to Morningdale.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - It's not nice.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Not nice?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: We just updated all the finger-paint sets.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Obviously, there are some real problems
or these people wouldn't have done this.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Exactly. Obviously, there are
some real problems or these people...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: You just said that, didn't you?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: You ought to wear a ski mask, skinhead.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
At least there's a reason
why my face looks like a fist.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Where did you find him, Bull?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Cafeteria.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
He was standing next to
the soup of the day.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: He was in it.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: They found her, they found Ann.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
She's holed up
in the broom closet in the...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I'm supposed to be hiding, aren't I?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Doctor, they found the woman
hiding somewhere...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I told them.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Poor thing, she must be terrified.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
She'd probably be more terrified
if she didn't have that snub-nosed.38.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I'd better get out there.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Crazy day, huh?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Ann, this is Harry Stone, the judge?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Listen, you got my word
that I'm not gonna hurt you...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...and neither is anyone else,
but you've got to come out of there.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
All right, if you're not coming out,
then I'm coming in.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Fools rush in
where wise men fear to tread.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: My mom always said I was special.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Hi.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Nice place you got here.
I love what you've done to it.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Hey, this room is so small, you'd have to
go outside to change your mind.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Come on, I don't really care
if you don't wanna talk.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Sometimes our tongues
just get us in trouble, right?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Say something to someone,
they take it the wrong way...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...and next thing you know, they're angry
or they're hurt or they're disappointed.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I mean, pfft.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I've said stuff, afterwards I wanted to rip
the tongue out my mouth, but I didn't do it.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Because if you rip out your tongue,
then your food tastes awfully bland, right?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Okay, a minister, a priest, and a rabbi...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: ...go miniature golfing...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Hi, Dan.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Hi.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - You ever been institutionalized?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Why do you ask?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
People always ask me
do I play basketball.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: But you're tall.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Uh-huh.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Uh, I'll have you know, I'm a very,
very well-adjusted member of society.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I happen to have a portfolio
that's worth over $ 75,000.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I always heard
money couldn't buy happiness.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: That's sick, Wendell.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Ann, I don't know what your problem is,
because you won't talk to me.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
And I don't know
why you won't talk to me.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
So I'm up the proverbial creek
without a paddle, aren't I?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Well, there, that was communication.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
You acknowledged me
when you nodded just then.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: You did. You wanna try it again?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Ann, do you wanna
go back to the hospital?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: No. Because everything's bad there?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: No? Some things are bad there?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Ann, I think maybe we can help you
and your friends.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I looked over this list, and most of these
demands seem totally justified to me.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Except for the, uh,
hot-air-balloon races...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: ...and embalming workshop.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Come on, Ann, let's go.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
You know, I read somewhere once,
that in order to keep people...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...from staying too long
and crowding up his sideshow tent...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...old P.T. Barnum
painted these huge banners that said:

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: "This way to the great egress!"

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
And sure enough, the whole crowd
just flocked over, through to the egress...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: ...which was the exit.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Because that's what an egress is,
you get it?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: It's a door. Not unlike this one.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Ann...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...that embalming stuff,
that was Gilbert's idea, wasn't it?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Come on. This way to the great egress.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Stop staring at me.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I'm not staring at you,
I'm trying to read my watch.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Hey, gang, look who's back.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - You okay, sir?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Oh, yeah, we're fine.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
We talked, we sang,
we had a few laughs.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: She talked to you?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: In a sense.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I've gone over this list and I feel these
people have made some legitimate points.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Listen, buster, I happen to have
prominent connections in civil law.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: And I'd be willing to help your patients...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...prepare a case to take you all the way
to the Supreme Court, if necessary.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: But you were saying?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
For example,
the right to open their own mail.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Well, we feel it's important to monitor
their communications from the outside...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...in case something should slip through
that might disturb them.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Like current events.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
That's a very good example,
Mr. Dworkin.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: What about curtains between the beds?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: To give them, quote:

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: "That sense of privacy and space...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...every human being needs
from time to time...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: ...to maintain his sanity and his dignity."

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I wrote that.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: With lipstick.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Are you through, Your Honor?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - No, I'm not.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
There's also the demand for a library,
the use of personal clothing...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: ...longer visiting hours.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I, uh, think the salad bar is negotiable.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
We got the makings
of one juicy lawsuit here, Osborne.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Listen, if you really have
the patients' best interests at heart...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: ...you won't take me to court.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - How do you figure that?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Simple.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Lf they win, I'm out of business.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Fine.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Fine maybe for you
and your legal principles.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - But what happens to them?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Yeah, what?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Chances are, they'll be put in an institution.
Is that in their best interests?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Oh, mercy.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: We'll be thrown in with the mentally ill.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Well, that's exactly what you're headed for
if we don't work something out.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Well, forget it, doctor, because
they're not interested in making any deals.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: What kind of deal?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
We might talk about
extending television privileges.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Absolutely not.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
The chance to watch a little extra TV
is not what's important here.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - How much TV?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - An extra hour a night.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Weekends or weeknights?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Don't you see what he's doing?
How you're being manipulated?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I think we can work something out.
What do you say, do we have a deal?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
No.
Yes.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
You got a few crumbs.
You can't give up now.

speaker: UNKNOWN
